note: Authored source for the 120 Basic families. tools/build_basic.py expands these choices into data/families.json and data/forms.json; edit an entry here and rebuild to revise one design.

families.name: Kindlet
families.personality: A jittery little kindler who only calms down once the ball is in his paws.

families.name: Charbun
families.personality: A coal-dark rabbit whose speckles glow when it hits the hole.

families.name: Sparkwick
families.personality: A wick-tailed fly that streaks downfield and forgets to look back for the ball.

families.name: Coalump
families.personality: A warm lump of coal that leans on defenders until they give up.

families.name: Kilnback
families.personality: Carries a little brick kiln on its back and never stops grumbling about the heat.

families.name: Scorchub
families.personality: An impatient cub that bursts off the line and burns out by the third quarter.

families.name: Embadger
families.personality: A smoldering badger who tackles everything, including the wrong thing.

families.name: Singecat
families.personality: A scorched-whisker alley cat who can run with anyone but rarely turns for the ball.

families.name: Ashpeck
families.personality: A soot-gray bird that dives on ball carriers and drifts out of its zone.

families.name: Fusebug
families.personality: A beetle with a fizzing fuse for antennae and a short, nervous temper.

families.name: Brookit
families.personality: A thoughtful little brook eel that reads the defense before it reads the playbook.

families.name: Ottrip
families.personality: A slippery otter that wriggles out of arm tackles and never picks up a blitz.

families.name: Minnodart
families.personality: A darting minnow with soft hands and very little top speed.

families.name: Kelpup
families.personality: A kelp-draped sea snake who finds the soft spot in a zone and sits down in it.

families.name: Barnaclod
families.personality: A barnacle-crusted tortoise that shuffles its feet well but gets pushed back by power.

families.name: Sploshog
families.personality: A shell-backed river hog that slips blocks with a splash and bounces off ball carriers.

families.name: Newtide
families.personality: A crested newt that drops into coverage gracefully and tackles like a wet towel.

families.name: Pondskip
families.personality: A water strider that mirrors every step and bounces off every block.

families.name: Wadelet
families.personality: A long-legged wader that patrols the deep middle and hates contact.

families.name: Bubblop
families.personality: A wobbling bubble who pops a kick straight through, then panics.

families.name: Acornet
families.personality: A stubborn acorn who stands in the pocket and takes the hit.

families.name: Thistlehop
families.personality: A prickly hare that carries the ball 25 times and never gets faster.

families.name: Fernflit
families.personality: A fern-winged fly that loves blocking downfield more than catching passes.

families.name: Stumpkin
families.personality: A sprouting stump that plants itself and makes defenders go around.

families.name: Trunkle
families.personality: A mossy little mammoth who blocks all game without tiring.

families.name: Briarhog
families.personality: A bramble-backed hog that holds its gap all day and never chases.

families.name: Barkbug
families.personality: A bark-armored beetle that grinds out tackles and loses every footrace.

families.name: Fawnleaf
families.personality: A leaf-spotted fawn that comes up hard in run support and gets beaten deep.

families.name: Ivyowl
families.personality: An ivy-wrapped owl that plays every snap and never quite catches up.

families.name: Podling
families.personality: A seed pod with a surprisingly strong leg and no interest in running.

families.name: Ampette
families.personality: A crackling beetle who scrambles first and aims later.

families.name: Fuzzvolt
families.personality: A static-fluffed mouse that zips outside on its hind legs and breaks on the first hit.

families.name: Boltdart
families.personality: A lightning-quick hound pup that wins with pure speed and never blocks.

families.name: Wattram
families.personality: A sparking ram who runs routes like a receiver and blocks like one too.

families.name: Capaclod
families.personality: A buzzing capacitor beetle that pulls fast and gets bowled over.

families.name: Zaphog
families.personality: A static-charged boar on two legs that shoots gaps and gets washed out by double teams.

families.name: Staticub
families.personality: A twitchy cub who flies to the ball and bounces off big backs.

families.name: Neonnewt
families.personality: A glowing newt that keeps pace with anyone and avoids every tackle.

families.name: Buzzhawk
families.personality: A buzzing hawk that covers ground fast and pulls up before contact.

families.name: Wattlet
families.personality: A firefly-bulbed bug that lights up on every make.

families.name: Slatelet
families.personality: A flat-headed slate sprite who shrugs off sacks but cannot escape them.

families.name: Gravelpup
families.personality: A gravel-coated pup that loves picking up blitzers more than carrying the ball.

families.name: Mudlark
families.personality: A muddy lark built like a fullback with wings.

families.name: Clodhorn
families.personality: A clod-headed rhino calf that blocks well and catches nothing thrown above its horn.

families.name: Cobblump
families.personality: A heap of cobblestones that refuses to move once it sets.

families.name: Quarrox
families.personality: A quarry ox that bull-rushes hard, reads the play late and misses tackles in space.

families.name: Diggit
families.personality: A burrowing mole who pops up in the backfield and gets lost in coverage.

families.name: Pumicat
families.personality: A pumice-coated cat that jams receivers hard and then trails them.

families.name: Siltadillo
families.personality: A silt-caked armadillo who hits hard and turns slowly.

families.name: Geodot
families.personality: A crystal golem cub with a geode heart and a heavy, long leg.

families.name: Chillip
families.personality: A cool-headed chick who places short throws perfectly and never runs.

families.name: Skiddle
families.personality: A sliding snowball critter that waits for the hole and slips on the cutback.

families.name: Snowdart
families.personality: A snow-white ermine that finds the open spot and sits in it.

families.name: Walrump
families.personality: A walrus calf who knows every assignment and is slower than all of them.

families.name: Floebear
families.personality: A floe-riding bear cub who reads stunts but gets bull-rushed.

families.name: Rimeboar
families.personality: A frosted boar that wraps up anything in its gap and cannot chase.

families.name: Hoarcub
families.personality: A frost-furred cub that reads passes well and gets run over.

families.name: Shiverkit
families.personality: A shivering fox kit with textbook zone technique and a slow backpedal.

families.name: Ptarmilet
families.personality: A snow-white grouse that always lines up right and arrives late.

families.name: Cubeling
families.personality: An ice cube that keeps its cool and its kicks straight.

families.name: Breezle
families.personality: A breezy dragonfly that dances away from pressure and flinches at contact.

families.name: Whirlhare
families.personality: A whirlwind hare that spins out of tackles and folds when it has to block.

families.name: Kitelet
families.personality: A kite-tailed bird that cuts on a dime and gets blown off its route.

families.name: Sailmoth
families.personality: A sail-winged moth that floats into soft spots and blocks like a curtain.

families.name: Nimbulk
families.personality: A puffy cloud that moves its feet nicely and gets pushed straight back.

families.name: Galebuck
families.personality: A gale-swift buck that loops around blockers and loses track of the ball.

families.name: Windrook
families.personality: A gusty rook that flits to the flat and misses tackles in traffic.

families.name: Swallit
families.personality: A fork-tailed swallow that mirrors routes and gets bodied by big receivers.

families.name: Pinwhirl
families.personality: A pinwheel-winged bug that spins toward the ball and away from collisions.

families.name: Gustpuff
families.personality: A puff-chested wind sparrow that can drift a kick but never powers one.

families.name: Murkit
families.personality: A masked imp who reads defenses in the dark and cannot throw deep.

families.name: Minkurk
families.personality: A long shadow mink that slithers through creases it seems to see first.

families.name: Batwhisk
families.personality: A bat with a whiplash cut and unreliable hands.

families.name: Gloamtoad
families.personality: A glowing-spotted toad who snatches passes and wilts in a block.

families.name: Umbruin
families.personality: A shadowy bear cub that sees every twist coming and tires fast.

families.name: Vexhound
families.personality: A vexing hound that reads the snap count and gets moved by power.

families.name: Crowlurk
families.personality: A lurking crow that drops into passing lanes and gets bowled over.

families.name: Spindlet
families.personality: A spindly spider that baits throws into its web and gets beaten by speed.

families.name: Gloomoth
families.personality: A dusk moth that drifts under deep balls and shies from contact.

families.name: Inklet
families.personality: An ink-black eel that splats a kick through and slinks away.

families.name: Beamlet
families.personality: A beaming little sunbeam with a sharp eye and a glass jaw.

families.name: Glowhare
families.personality: A lantern beetle that glows brightest catching passes out of the backfield.

families.name: Dawnfinch
families.personality: A dawn-feathered finch that catches anything and bruises easily.

families.name: Lanternox
families.personality: A lantern-horned ox who walks upright, lights up open zones and lumbers into them.

families.name: Waxwick
families.personality: A candle with a calm flame and slow, careful feet.

families.name: Solram
families.personality: A sun-bright ram who stands tall, reads the run well and gets driven off the ball.

families.name: Lumbear
families.personality: A haloed bear cub with soft hands and soft tackles.

families.name: Glarefly
families.personality: A glaring firefly that breaks on throws and flutters off ball carriers.

families.name: Dazzlet
families.personality: A dazzling sprite who sees the throw early and gets there slowly.

families.name: Twinklet
families.personality: A star-speckled songbird that kicks true when the lights are brightest.

families.name: Rivetto
families.personality: A riveted tin turtle that takes every sack and rattles back up.

families.name: Tinhare
families.personality: A tin-plated hare in a riveted shell, built to take hits, not make people miss.

families.name: Springlet
families.personality: A coiled spring bug that catches over the middle and bounces up every time.

families.name: Anvilox
families.personality: An anvil-headed ox calf that blocks all day and lumbers on routes.

families.name: Kettlump
families.personality: A dented kettle-shelled tortoise that whistles when pushed, which is rarely.

families.name: Ingotusk
families.personality: A nearly square ingot of a hog that holds the point and never chases.

families.name: Brasshound
families.personality: A brass-collared hound that plays every down and drops easy picks.

families.name: Gyroflit
families.personality: A gyroscope-winged bug that never wobbles and never quite turns fast.

families.name: Clockcrow
families.personality: A clockwork crow that walks upright, keeps perfect time and has stiff hips.

families.name: Washerling
families.personality: A washer-shelled snail that kicks steadily and moves slowly.

families.name: Mindle
families.personality: A tiny sprite with a big forehead that sees the blitz and crumples under it.

families.name: Dreamhop
families.personality: A dreamy cloud-puff that floats out for screens and dozes through contact.

families.name: Trancefin
families.personality: A hypnotic fish that drifts into open space and avoids all contact.

families.name: Pondermoose
families.personality: A pensive moose calf who always seems to be thinking about something else.

families.name: Thinkump
families.personality: A brainy blob that calls every protection and gets pushed around executing it.

families.name: Omenox
families.personality: A horned river serpent that senses the snap and slips off the tackle.

families.name: Seerling
families.personality: A haloed seer who knows where the play goes and gets there late.

families.name: Riddlet
families.personality: A masked fox kit that seems to know every route and wears down quickly.

families.name: Gazeling
families.personality: A wide-eyed little gazelle that stares down the quarterback and wilts against power.

families.name: Orblet
families.personality: A floating orb that lines up every kick with eerie focus.

families.name: Scalekin
families.personality: A young scaled drake with a cannon arm and no idea where it is going.

families.name: Raptlet
families.personality: A sprinting raptor hatchling that runs hard and runs the wrong way.

families.name: Glidrake
families.personality: A gliding drake that outruns coverage and freezes when the play breaks down.

families.name: Crestback

families.name: Bulwyrm
families.personality: A thick-coiled wyrm that walls off rushers and loses track of stunts.

families.name: Gnashlet
families.personality: A gnashing hatchling that bites down on ball carriers and bites on every fake.

families.name: Drakhound

families.name: Wyvlet
families.personality: A little wyvern that hits like a safety and covers like one too.

families.name: Skinklet
families.personality: A striped skink that flies to the ball and overruns the angle.

families.name: Eggling
families.personality: A dragon egg with little horns poking through and a hard-shelled leg.
